commands.review_summary:
The PR caps the LINE plugin's in-process user profile cache at 1,024 entries using the shared map-pruning helper and adds a regression test plus a test cache reset export.

PR surface: Source +17, Tests +21. Total +38 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: no. high-confidence live reproduction was established in this read-only review; current main clearly has an uncapped module-level LINE profile cache by source inspection.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] A narrow mechanical follow-up can refresh cache-hit recency and test the invariant; contributor-supplied runtime proof is still needed separately.

target.title: fix(line): cap user profile cache
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an unbounded in-process **`userProfileCache`** in the LINE send path. Profile lookups are cached for 5 minutes but had no size cap, so gateways serving many distinct LINE users could grow memory without limit.

## Why This Change Was Made

Extracts `cacheLineUserProfile` and applies `pruneMapToMaxSize` after each write, capped at **1 024 entries** with LRU eviction.

## User Impact

Long-lived LINE gateways get bounded profile-cache memory. Behavior is unchanged for the first 1 024 distinct cached users within the TTL window.

## Evidence

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/line/src/send.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** LINE user profile cache grew without bound under high distinct-user volume.
- **Real environment tested:** macOS (Darwin arm64), Node.js v22.22.0, local source checkout on branch `fix/line-cap-user-profile-cache`.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/line/src/send.test.ts --reporter=verbose`
- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
 ✓ evicts oldest profile cache entries once the cache exceeds its cap

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  16 passed (16)
```

- **Observed result after fix:** After 1 025 profile fetches the oldest cached user is evicted and the next lookup re-fetches from the API mock; newest entries remain cached.
- **What was not tested:** Live LINE Messaging API profile fetch.
